finding_summary: Current WP807 is a useful four-capability diagnostic aggregator but does not prove integrated agentic composition.
Four separately accepted WP802-WP805 records can satisfy the current bundle without one shared agent/build/policy, episode, run package or causal trajectory.
holdout_set_id string equality is metadata agreement, not proof of consumed hidden fixture/family identity.
Preserve component diagnostics and add a separate same-agent same-episode integrated trajectory gate before widening acceptance wording.
The integrated episode must bind first-contact provenance, held-out family/fixture commitment, one causal trajectory, completion evidence and feedback-driven recovery.
Do not mint an ARC score or a generic intelligence scalar; preserve completion, external actions, internal compute and recovery diagnostics as distinct axes.
WP806 lesion/sham/rescue remains causal subsystem evidence and should later be applied to matched integrated trajectories, not treated as integrated-agency proof by itself.
external_basis: On the Measure of Intelligence arXiv:1911.01547

architecture_delta.nonduplicate_boundary: internal compute efficiency is owned by the parallel WP807 internal-compute E2 delta; broad cross-benchmark generalization is owned by its separate E2 claim; this delta owns same-agent/same-episode causal composition and terminal completion identity

handoff: Trigger 4 should preserve the existing diagnostic aggregator and add only the smallest fail-closed integrated-episode boundary before any integrated/general agentic-core support claim. Trigger 6 grants no build/runtime acceptance.
mirror_policy: Provenance mirror only. F2 owns the claim mutex and canonical result.
